_meta.note: weeks 1-2 are not scored because there is no honest training history before them; they are skipped and counted, never imputed

benchmarks.base_rate: home-win rate of the scored sample (climatology)
benchmarks.favorites_only: always take the side the closing spread favours

moneyline.verdict: model is WORSE than the market on Brier score; the paired interval is the published uncertainty, not a claim of skill

spread.note: two different comparisons, published separately on purpose: the first is how far our fair spread sits from the closing line (a pricing-distance measure), the second is how far the closing line sits from the actual result (a market-accuracy measure). Comparing our line directly to the result is NOT a skill measure and is not published.
spread.sign_convention: verifiable: r(close_spread_home, home_margin) > 0 and the mirror sign fits worse; see spread_convention_check

total.decision: KEEP BOTH published - the gap does not separate them at this n
